title: PHP2Shell: AI uncovers critical RCE in PHP
title_zh: PHP2Shell：AI 发现 PHP 中的严重远程代码执行（RCE）漏洞

paragraphs.en: Core PHP engine flaws enable remote code execution and Heartbleed-style memory disclosure across the web.
paragraphs.zh: PHP 核心引擎的缺陷导致远程代码执行以及“心脏出血”式的内存泄露问题遍布整个网络。

paragraphs.en: Wiz Research uncovered multiple critical vulnerabilities in core PHP, a popular general-purpose scripting language that powers 70% of all websites in the world. Successful exploitation could allow attackers to take control of affected servers, steal sensitive data, and deface the websites running on them.
paragraphs.zh: Wiz Research 发现了 PHP 核心中的多个严重漏洞，PHP 是一种流行的通用脚本语言，为全球 70% 的网站提供支持。 成功利用这些漏洞可能使攻击者控制受影响的服务器、窃取敏感数据，并篡改其上运行的网站。

sents.en: Wiz Research uncovered multiple critical vulnerabilities in core PHP, a popular general-purpose scripting language that powers 70% of all websites in the world.
sents.zh: Wiz Research 发现了 PHP 核心中的多个严重漏洞，PHP 是一种流行的通用脚本语言，为全球 70% 的网站提供支持。

sents.en: Successful exploitation could allow attackers to take control of affected servers, steal sensitive data, and deface the websites running on them.
sents.zh: 成功利用这些漏洞可能使攻击者控制受影响的服务器、窃取敏感数据，并篡改其上运行的网站。

paragraphs.en: PHP is a backbone of the web: it’s the programming language powering WordPress, Joomla, Drupal, Wikipedia’s MediaWiki, and many others.
paragraphs.zh: PHP 是 Web 的支柱：它是驱动 WordPress、Joomla、Drupal、维基百科的 MediaWiki 以及许多其他系统的编程语言。

paragraphs.en: These vulnerabilities include memory disclosure and unauthenticated remote code execution in PHP itself, independent of the application running on top of it , putting every affected website in immediate risk.
paragraphs.zh: 这些漏洞包括 PHP 本身存在的内存信息泄露和未经身份验证的远程代码执行，与运行在其上的应用程序无关，使每个受影响的网站都面临直接风险。

paragraphs.en: Every PHP version released in the last decade is affected by at least one of these vulnerabilities, going back to version 5.4. Attackers can exploit them remotely, in some cases fairly easily. Immediate patching is strongly advised.
paragraphs.zh: 过去十年发布的每个 PHP 版本都至少受到其中一个漏洞的影响，最早可追溯到 5.4 版本。 攻击者可以远程利用这些漏洞，某些情况下利用起来相当容易。 强烈建议立即打补丁。

sents.en: Every PHP version released in the last decade is affected by at least one of these vulnerabilities, going back to version 5.4.
sents.zh: 过去十年发布的每个 PHP 版本都至少受到其中一个漏洞的影响，最早可追溯到 5.4 版本。

sents.en: Attackers can exploit them remotely, in some cases fairly easily.
sents.zh: 攻击者可以远程利用这些漏洞，某些情况下利用起来相当容易。

sents.en: Immediate patching is strongly advised.
sents.zh: 强烈建议立即打补丁。

paragraphs.en: On October 21, 2026, PHP released the patch fixing multiple memory-safety vulnerabilities in the core engine.
paragraphs.zh: 2026年10月21日，PHP 发布了修复核心引擎中多个内存安全漏洞的补丁。

paragraphs.en: These findings rank among the most severe vulnerabilities discovered in PHP, and arguably in software history. The underlying flaws had been present for decades, but demonstrating their exploitability required an exceptionally complex chain of steps, at the edge of what human researchers could practically achieve. Frontier AI models substantially reduced that barrier, turning a longstanding flaw into an exploit.
paragraphs.zh: 这些发现在 PHP 历史上——可以说在整个软件史上——都属于最严重的漏洞之列。 其底层缺陷已存在数十年，但要证明其可利用性，需要一条极其复杂的步骤链条，已处于人类研究人员实际能力所能企及的边缘。 前沿 AI 智能体大幅降低了这一门槛，将一个长期存在的缺陷变成了可利用的漏洞。

sents.en: These findings rank among the most severe vulnerabilities discovered in PHP, and arguably in software history.
sents.zh: 这些发现在 PHP 历史上——可以说在整个软件史上——都属于最严重的漏洞之列。

sents.en: The underlying flaws had been present for decades, but demonstrating their exploitability required an exceptionally complex chain of steps, at the edge of what human researchers could practically achieve.
sents.zh: 其底层缺陷已存在数十年，但要证明其可利用性，需要一条极其复杂的步骤链条，已处于人类研究人员实际能力所能企及的边缘。

sents.en: Frontier AI models substantially reduced that barrier, turning a longstanding flaw into an exploit.
sents.zh: 前沿 AI 智能体大幅降低了这一门槛，将一个长期存在的缺陷变成了可利用的漏洞。

paragraphs.en: In this post, we explain how frontier AI helped us find and fix vulnerabilities that had remained hidden in the PHP codebase for more than a decade. The issues described below all stem from key architecture decisions, some made over a decade ago, and were grouped under two CVEs, with severity reaching CVSS 9.2. The work grew into a cross-industry effort to protect customers, find variants, deploy detections and mitigations, and verify a patch in time for coordinated disclosure.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们将说明前沿人工智能如何帮助我们发现并修复了在 PHP 代码库中隐藏了十多年的漏洞。 下文描述的问题都源于关键的架构决策，其中一些决策是在十多年前做出的，这些问题被归入两个 CVE，严重程度最高达到 CVSS 9.2。 这项工作最终发展为一项跨行业的协作，旨在保护客户、查找变体、部署检测与缓解措施，并在协调披露的时限内及时验证补丁。

sents.en: In this post, we explain how frontier AI helped us find and fix vulnerabilities that had remained hidden in the PHP codebase for more than a decade.
sents.zh: 在本文中，我们将说明前沿人工智能如何帮助我们发现并修复了在 PHP 代码库中隐藏了十多年的漏洞。

paragraphs.en: Nearly every PHP version is affected by at least one of these issues, including releases dating back to PHP 5.4. The vulnerabilities can allow unauthenticated attackers to execute code on affected servers or read sensitive process memory. That memory may contain passwords, authentication tokens, API keys and certificates belonging to other requests or the server itself.
paragraphs.zh: 几乎每个 PHP 版本都至少受其中一个问题的影响，包括可以追溯到 PHP 5.4 的版本。 这些漏洞可允许未经身份验证的攻击者在受影响的服务器上执行代码或读取敏感的进程内存。 这些内存可能包含属于其他请求或服务器本身的密码、身份验证令牌、API 密钥和证书。

paragraphs.en: PHP is the programming language behind much of the web, powering WordPress, Drupal and MediaWiki, the software that runs Wikipedia. A flaw in its core engine can affect websites across this ecosystem, even when their own application code is secure.
paragraphs.zh: PHP 是支撑着网络大部分内容的编程语言，为 WordPress、Drupal 和 MediaWiki 提供动力，MediaWiki 正是运行维基百科的软件。 其核心引擎中的一个缺陷可能会影响该生态系统中的各类网站，即使它们自身的应用代码是安全的。

sents.en: A flaw in its core engine can affect websites across this ecosystem, even when their own application code is secure.
sents.zh: 其核心引擎中的一个缺陷可能会影响该生态系统中的各类网站，即使它们自身的应用代码是安全的。

paragraphs.en: Some vulnerabilities become turning points because they challenge fundamental assumptions about security. In 2014, Heartbleed exposed the fragility of shared infrastructure securing the internet. In 2021, Log4Shell revealed how deeply embedded software dependencies could create widespread exposure that organizations struggled to identify. We believe PHP2Shell could mark a similar turning point for the AI era, illustrating how AI can change the practical exploitability of longstanding vulnerabilities. Building the exploit required chaining multiple flaws and adapting to each target’s memory layout through repeated testing and debugging. Frontier models were critical to making this process practical, enabling us to develop and adapt working exploits across multiple applications in hours. As the time and expertise required for this work decrease, complexity may no longer provide a meaningful barrier, changing how we define what is vulnerable in practice.
paragraphs.zh: 一些漏洞之所以成为转折点，是因为它们挑战了关于安全的基本假设。 2014 年，Heartbleed 暴露了保护互联网的共享基础设施的脆弱性。 2021 年，Log4Shell 揭示了深度嵌入的软件依赖可能造成组织难以识别的大范围暴露面。 我们认为 PHP2Shell 可能标志着 AI 时代的一个类似转折点，它展示了 AI 如何改变长期存在漏洞的实际可利用性。 构建该利用链需要串联多个缺陷，并通过反复测试和调试来适应每个目标的内存布局。 前沿模型对使这一过程切实可行至关重要，使我们能够在数小时内为多个应用程序开发和调整可用的利用代码。 随着这项工作所需的时间和专业知识不断减少，复杂性可能不再构成有意义的屏障，这将改变我们在实践中对“什么算漏洞”的定义。

paragraphs.en: Wiz Research would like to thank the PHP team, Calif and OpenAI for their work on discovery, coordination and patch verification. OpenAI and Calif also published blogs containing details on the vulnerability – its history, technical details, and insight into the disclosure process. PHP posted as well.
paragraphs.zh: Wiz Research 谨此感谢 PHP 团队、Calif 以及 OpenAI 在漏洞发现、协调与补丁验证方面所做的努力。 OpenAI 与 Calif 也发布了博客，其中包含该漏洞的详细信息——其历史、技术细节以及对披露过程的深入解读。PHP 同样发布了相关文章。

paragraphs.en: We’d also like to express our sincere gratitude towards Automattic, Akamai, AWS, Cloudflare , Fastly , Google , Imperva, Microsoft, Vercel , and many others, for helping prepare guidance and out-of-the-box mitigations for customers who cannot apply the patch immediately.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还要向 Automattic、Akamai、AWS、Cloudflare、Fastly、Google、Imperva、Microsoft、Vercel 以及许多其他公司表示诚挚的感谢，感谢他们为无法立即应用补丁的客户准备了指导说明和开箱即用的缓解措施。

paragraphs.en: All of the disclosed vulnerabilities are memory-safety issues that stem from bugs in how PHP handles fatal errors while processing requests, particularly out-of-memory errors. These bugs can leave a corrupted internal PHP state behind after a request ends unexpectedly. A later request or worker can reuse that stale state, leading to memory disclosure or corruption.
paragraphs.zh: 所有披露的漏洞都是内存安全问题，其根源在于 PHP 在处理请求时对致命错误的处理方式存在缺陷，尤其是内存耗尽错误。 这些缺陷可能在请求意外结束后遗留损坏的 PHP 内部状态。 后续的请求或工作进程可能复用这种过期状态，从而导致内存信息泄露或内存损坏。

sents.en: All of the disclosed vulnerabilities are memory-safety issues that stem from bugs in how PHP handles fatal errors while processing requests, particularly out-of-memory errors.

sents.zh: 这些缺陷可能在请求意外结束后遗留损坏的 PHP 内部状态。

sents.zh: 后续的请求或工作进程可能复用这种过期状态，从而导致内存信息泄露或内存损坏。

paragraphs.en: While this blog covers only four instances of exploitable bugs (grouped under two CVEs) that follow this problematic pattern, there are other tracked, and likely untracked, variants of this issue in the PHP codebase. These variants have different requirements for exploitation and can lead to different types of impact. In any case, the patch provided by the PHP team fixes the issue at its core and eliminates all variants in the patched release.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管本博客只涵盖了四个遵循这一有问题的模式的可利用漏洞实例（归入两个 CVE），但 PHP 代码库中还存在其他已被追踪以及很可能未被追踪的此类问题的变体。 这些变体具有不同的利用要求，并可能导致不同类型的影响。 无论如何，PHP 团队提供的补丁从核心上修复了该问题，并在已修补的版本中消除了所有变体。

paragraphs.en: We combined these vulnerabilities into a single exploit script, php2shell, and demonstrated that it could execute code remotely without authentication on deployments of WordPress ( wordpress:latest ), Drupal ( drupal:latest ), and Joomla ( joomla:latest ), using their latest container images at the time of testing.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将这些漏洞组合成一个单一的利用脚本 php2shell，并证明它可以在 WordPress（ wordpress:latest ）、Drupal（ drupal:latest ）和 Joomla（ joomla:latest ）的部署上无需身份验证即可远程执行代码，测试时均使用其最新的容器镜像。

paragraphs.en: These platforms illustrate the impact, but the vulnerabilities are in PHP itself. Exploitation does not depend on a flaw in the application’s code: even a simple “Hello World” application running on an affected PHP version can be vulnerable.
paragraphs.zh: 这些平台说明了其影响，但漏洞存在于 PHP 本身。 利用这些漏洞并不取决于应用程序代码中的缺陷：即使在受影响的 PHP 版本上运行的简单“Hello World”应用程序也可能存在漏洞。

sents.en: These platforms illustrate the impact, but the vulnerabilities are in PHP itself.
sents.zh: 这些平台说明了其影响，但漏洞存在于 PHP 本身。

sents.en: Exploitation does not depend on a flaw in the application’s code: even a simple “Hello World” application running on an affected PHP version can be vulnerable.
sents.zh: 利用这些漏洞并不取决于应用程序代码中的缺陷：即使在受影响的 PHP 版本上运行的简单“Hello World”应用程序也可能存在漏洞。

paragraphs.en: Separately, we demonstrated that attackers could read sensitive data from the PHP process’s memory, including passwords, tokens, and API keys, without needing to achieve remote code execution.
paragraphs.zh: 另外，我们证明了攻击者可以从 PHP 进程的内存中读取敏感数据，包括密码、令牌和 API 密钥，而无需实现远程代码执行。

paragraphs.en: The vulnerable code had been present for more than a decade. Turning these flaws into working exploits required chaining multiple bugs and accounting for how PHP allocates and reuses memory across requests. Memory bugs are notoriously complex; differences in PHP versions, configurations and application behavior can break assumptions the exploit depends on. An attack that works against one deployment may need substantial adjustments to work against another, each requiring further analysis, testing and debugging. Pre-AI, this manual work would be difficult to implement and even harder to scale.
paragraphs.zh: 漏洞代码已经存在了十多年。 要将这些缺陷变成可用的漏洞利用程序，需要串联多个漏洞，并考虑 PHP 如何在多个请求之间分配和复用内存。 内存类漏洞向来复杂；PHP 版本、配置和应用行为的差异都可能破坏漏洞利用所依赖的前提假设。 针对某一部署环境有效的攻击，可能需要进行大幅调整才能对另一部署环境生效，而每一次调整都需要进一步的分析、测试和调试。 在人工智能出现之前，这类手工工作难以实现，更难以规模化。

sents.en: The vulnerable code had been present for more than a decade.
sents.zh: 漏洞代码已经存在了十多年。

sents.en: Turning these flaws into working exploits required chaining multiple bugs and accounting for how PHP allocates and reuses memory across requests.
sents.zh: 要将这些缺陷变成可用的漏洞利用程序，需要串联多个漏洞，并考虑 PHP 如何在多个请求之间分配和复用内存。

sents.en: Memory bugs are notoriously complex; differences in PHP versions, configurations and application behavior can break assumptions the exploit depends on.
sents.zh: 内存类漏洞向来复杂；PHP 版本、配置和应用行为的差异都可能破坏漏洞利用所依赖的前提假设。

sents.en: An attack that works against one deployment may need substantial adjustments to work against another, each requiring further analysis, testing and debugging.
sents.zh: 针对某一部署环境有效的攻击，可能需要进行大幅调整才能对另一部署环境生效，而每一次调整都需要进一步的分析、测试和调试。

sents.en: Pre-AI, this manual work would be difficult to implement and even harder to scale.
sents.zh: 在人工智能出现之前，这类手工工作难以实现，更难以规模化。

paragraphs.en: With AI this is no longer a barrier. LLMs can help adapt an exploit to different PHP versions, configurations and memory layouts. With testing and debugging tools, models can analyze failures and iterate on adjustments, reducing the specialist effort required for each target. This significantly lowers the barrier to scaling attacks across different deployments.
paragraphs.zh: 有了人工智能，这不再是一个障碍。 大语言模型可以帮助将漏洞利用适配到不同的 PHP 版本、配置和内存布局。 借助测试和调试工具，模型可以分析失败原因并迭代调整，从而减少针对每个目标所需的专业人员投入。 这显著降低了跨不同部署环境扩展攻击的门槛。

sents.en: With AI this is no longer a barrier.
sents.zh: 有了人工智能，这不再是一个障碍。

sents.en: LLMs can help adapt an exploit to different PHP versions, configurations and memory layouts.
sents.zh: 大语言模型可以帮助将漏洞利用适配到不同的 PHP 版本、配置和内存布局。

sents.en: With testing and debugging tools, models can analyze failures and iterate on adjustments, reducing the specialist effort required for each target.
sents.zh: 借助测试和调试工具，模型可以分析失败原因并迭代调整，从而减少针对每个目标所需的专业人员投入。

sents.en: This significantly lowers the barrier to scaling attacks across different deployments.
sents.zh: 这显著降低了跨不同部署环境扩展攻击的门槛。

paragraphs.en: This changes the economics of both discovery and exploitation. As AI reduces the effort needed to develop and adapt complex exploits, vulnerabilities that once seemed impractical to exploit become viable targets.
paragraphs.zh: 这改变了发现与利用（漏洞）两方面的经济学。 随着智能体降低了开发和改造复杂漏洞利用程序所需的投入，那些曾经被认为不切实际、难以利用的漏洞成为了可行的攻击目标。

sents.en: This changes the economics of both discovery and exploitation.
sents.zh: 这改变了发现与利用（漏洞）两方面的经济学。

sents.en: As AI reduces the effort needed to develop and adapt complex exploits, vulnerabilities that once seemed impractical to exploit become viable targets.
sents.zh: 随着智能体降低了开发和改造复杂漏洞利用程序所需的投入，那些曾经被认为不切实际、难以利用的漏洞成为了可行的攻击目标。

paragraphs.en: We used Wiz Atlas , Gemini 4 Argon and GPT-5.6 Sol throughout this research. Notably, Gemini 4 Argon made an invaluable contribution to finding the vulnerability, exploit development, attack detection, and validation of the patch.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在整个研究过程中使用了 Wiz Atlas、Gemini 4 Argon 和 GPT-5.6 Sol。 值得注意的是，Gemini 4 Argon 在发现漏洞、漏洞利用开发、攻击检测以及补丁验证方面做出了宝贵的贡献。

sents.en: We used Wiz Atlas , Gemini 4 Argon and GPT-5.6 Sol throughout this research.
sents.zh: 我们在整个研究过程中使用了 Wiz Atlas、Gemini 4 Argon 和 GPT-5.6 Sol。

sents.en: Notably, Gemini 4 Argon made an invaluable contribution to finding the vulnerability, exploit development, attack detection, and validation of the patch.
sents.zh: 值得注意的是，Gemini 4 Argon 在发现漏洞、漏洞利用开发、攻击检测以及补丁验证方面做出了宝贵的贡献。

paragraphs.en: Using Gemini 4 Argon, the team at Wiz has shown why frontier AI is a game-changer for cyber defense. For over a decade, these critical vulnerabilities remained unaddressed because vulnerability discovery and exploitation were incredibly complex. We're pleased to see Gemini 4 Argon help defenders bridge that gap, finding vulnerabilities and helping patch them.
paragraphs.zh: Wiz 团队利用 Gemini 4 Argon 展示了为什么前沿 AI 是网络防御领域的一场变革。 十多年来，这些关键漏洞一直未得到修复，因为漏洞发现与利用的过程极其复杂。 我们很高兴看到 Gemini 4 Argon 帮助防御者弥合这一差距，发现漏洞并协助修复它们。

sents.en: Using Gemini 4 Argon, the team at Wiz has shown why frontier AI is a game-changer for cyber defense.
sents.zh: Wiz 团队利用 Gemini 4 Argon 展示了为什么前沿 AI 是网络防御领域的一场变革。

sents.en: For over a decade, these critical vulnerabilities remained unaddressed because vulnerability discovery and exploitation were incredibly complex.
sents.zh: 十多年来，这些关键漏洞一直未得到修复，因为漏洞发现与利用的过程极其复杂。

sents.en: We're pleased to see Gemini 4 Argon help defenders bridge that gap, finding vulnerabilities and helping patch them.
sents.zh: 我们很高兴看到 Gemini 4 Argon 帮助防御者弥合这一差距，发现漏洞并协助修复它们。

paragraphs.en: Prior to public disclosure, Wiz Research worked with the PHP team, Calif and OpenAI on discovery, coordination and patch verification. We also partnered with Google Cloud, Cloudflare, AWS, Microsoft, Automattic, Fastly, Akamai, Imperva, Vercel and many others to prepare customer guidance, detections and out-of-the-box mitigations for organizations that cannot update immediately.
paragraphs.zh: 在公开披露之前，Wiz Research 与 PHP 团队、Calif 和 OpenAI 合作进行了发现、协调和补丁验证工作。 我们还与 Google Cloud、Cloudflare、AWS、Microsoft、Automattic、Fastly、Akamai、Imperva、Vercel 以及其他许多公司合作，为无法立即更新的组织准备了客户指引、检测方法和开箱即用的缓解措施。

sents.en: Prior to public disclosure, Wiz Research worked with the PHP team, Calif and OpenAI on discovery, coordination and patch verification.
sents.zh: 在公开披露之前，Wiz Research 与 PHP 团队、Calif 和 OpenAI 合作进行了发现、协调和补丁验证工作。

sents.en: We also partnered with Google Cloud, Cloudflare, AWS, Microsoft, Automattic, Fastly, Akamai, Imperva, Vercel and many others to prepare customer guidance, detections and out-of-the-box mitigations for organizations that cannot update immediately.
sents.zh: 我们还与 Google Cloud、Cloudflare、AWS、Microsoft、Automattic、Fastly、Akamai、Imperva、Vercel 以及其他许多公司合作，为无法立即更新的组织准备了客户指引、检测方法和开箱即用的缓解措施。

paragraphs.en: A vulnerability in core PHP reaches far beyond a single application. PHP runs across clouds, hosting providers, content-delivery networks and millions of independently managed servers. Reducing exposure before the technical details became public required coordinated work across that entire ecosystem.
paragraphs.zh: 核心 PHP 中的一个漏洞，其影响远不止单个应用程序。 PHP 运行在云服务、托管提供商、内容分发网络以及数百万台独立管理的服务器上。 在技术细节公开之前减少暴露，需要整个生态系统的协调工作。

sents.en: A vulnerability in core PHP reaches far beyond a single application.
sents.zh: 核心 PHP 中的一个漏洞，其影响远不止单个应用程序。

sents.en: PHP runs across clouds, hosting providers, content-delivery networks and millions of independently managed servers.
sents.zh: PHP 运行在云服务、托管提供商、内容分发网络以及数百万台独立管理的服务器上。

sents.en: Reducing exposure before the technical details became public required coordinated work across that entire ecosystem.
sents.zh: 在技术细节公开之前减少暴露，需要整个生态系统的协调工作。

paragraphs.en: PHP's Session module can decode session data during upload-progress handling in the same pre-initialization window. The decoder stores request-owned bookkeeping in BG(unserialize) . A fatal allocation failure can interrupt this path, destroy the request heap and leave the unserializer's global state published.
paragraphs.zh: PHP 的 Session 模块可以在上传进度处理的同一个预初始化窗口内解码会话数据。 该解码器在 BG(unserialize) 中存储请求所有的簿记数据。 致命的内存分配失败可能中断此路径，销毁请求堆，并使反序列化器的全局状态保持已发布状态。

sents.en: PHP's Session module can decode session data during upload-progress handling in the same pre-initialization window.
sents.zh: PHP 的 Session 模块可以在上传进度处理的同一个预初始化窗口内解码会话数据。

sents.en: The decoder stores request-owned bookkeeping in BG(unserialize) .
sents.zh: 该解码器在 BG(unserialize) 中存储请求所有的簿记数据。

sents.en: A fatal allocation failure can interrupt this path, destroy the request heap and leave the unserializer's global state published.
sents.zh: 致命的内存分配失败可能中断此路径，销毁请求堆，并使反序列化器的全局状态保持已发布状态。

paragraphs.en: On a later request handled by the same worker, PHP can consume attacker-reclaimed memory as live unserializer bookkeeping. The stale state becomes a powerful memory-corruption primitive. We combined it with the memory disclosure to remove address uncertainty and achieved unauthenticated remote code execution on WordPress, Drupal and Joomla.
paragraphs.zh: 在稍后由同一个 worker 处理的请求中，PHP 可能会把攻击者回收的内存当作处于活跃状态的 unserializer 簿记数据来使用。 这种过期状态会成为一个强大的内存破坏原语。 我们将其与内存信息泄露相结合，消除了地址的不确定性，从而在 WordPress、Drupal 和 Joomla 上实现了无需身份验证的远程代码执行。

sents.en: On a later request handled by the same worker, PHP can consume attacker-reclaimed memory as live unserializer bookkeeping.
sents.zh: 在稍后由同一个 worker 处理的请求中，PHP 可能会把攻击者回收的内存当作处于活跃状态的 unserializer 簿记数据来使用。

sents.en: The stale state becomes a powerful memory-corruption primitive.
sents.zh: 这种过期状态会成为一个强大的内存破坏原语。

sents.en: We combined it with the memory disclosure to remove address uncertainty and achieved unauthenticated remote code execution on WordPress, Drupal and Joomla.
sents.zh: 我们将其与内存信息泄露相结合，消除了地址的不确定性，从而在 WordPress、Drupal 和 Joomla 上实现了无需身份验证的远程代码执行。

paragraphs.en: The WordPress, Drupal and Joomla chains are representative demonstrations. The underlying primitives exist at the PHP engine level and can affect any PHP application running on a vulnerable version.
paragraphs.zh: WordPress、Drupal 和 Joomla 的攻击链是具有代表性的演示。 底层原语存在于 PHP 引擎层面，可以影响运行在受影响版本上的任何 PHP 应用程序。

sents.en: The WordPress, Drupal and Joomla chains are representative demonstrations.
sents.zh: WordPress、Drupal 和 Joomla 的攻击链是具有代表性的演示。

sents.en: The underlying primitives exist at the PHP engine level and can affect any PHP application running on a vulnerable version.
sents.zh: 底层原语存在于 PHP 引擎层面，可以影响运行在受影响版本上的任何 PHP 应用程序。

paragraphs.en: These issues execute below the application layer, so application logs may contain little context. Until systems are patched, defenders should pay particular attention to unusual multipart requests followed by memory-limit errors or repeated HTTP 500 responses, unexpectedly large or malformed PHPSESSID response cookies, and unexplained PHP worker churn. These signals can guide an investigation. Applying the PHP security update remains the only complete remediation.
paragraphs.zh: 这些问题在应用层之下执行，因此应用日志中可能几乎不包含相关上下文。 在系统完成修补之前，防御者应特别关注以下异常迹象：伴随内存限制错误或反复出现 HTTP 500 响应的异常多部分请求，异常偏大或格式错误的 PHPSESSID 响应 Cookie，以及原因不明的 PHP 工作进程频繁变动。 这些信号可以为调查提供指引。 应用 PHP 安全更新仍然是唯一的彻底修复措施。

sents.en: These issues execute below the application layer, so application logs may contain little context.
sents.zh: 这些问题在应用层之下执行，因此应用日志中可能几乎不包含相关上下文。

sents.en: Until systems are patched, defenders should pay particular attention to unusual multipart requests followed by memory-limit errors or repeated HTTP 500 responses, unexpectedly large or malformed PHPSESSID response cookies, and unexplained PHP worker churn.
sents.zh: 在系统完成修补之前，防御者应特别关注以下异常迹象：伴随内存限制错误或反复出现 HTTP 500 响应的异常多部分请求，异常偏大或格式错误的 PHPSESSID 响应 Cookie，以及原因不明的 PHP 工作进程频繁变动。

sents.en: These signals can guide an investigation.
sents.zh: 这些信号可以为调查提供指引。

sents.en: Applying the PHP security update remains the only complete remediation.
sents.zh: 应用 PHP 安全更新仍然是唯一的彻底修复措施。

paragraphs.en: PHP parses RFC1867 multipart requests during request startup, before normal module initialization has completed. Session upload-progress handling can initialize Session state at this early stage and publish a session ID in PS(id) . An out-of-memory error can abort the request before cleanup completes. PHP then destroys the request heap and may leave PS(id) pointing to the freed allocation.
paragraphs.zh: PHP 在请求启动阶段、即正常模块初始化完成之前，就会解析 RFC1867 多部分（multipart）请求。 会话上传进度处理可以在此早期阶段初始化会话状态，并在 PS(id) 中发布一个会话 ID。 内存不足错误可能在清理完成之前中止请求。 随后 PHP 会销毁请求堆，可能使 PS(id) 仍然指向已被释放的内存分配。

sents.en: PHP parses RFC1867 multipart requests during request startup, before normal module initialization has completed.
sents.zh: PHP 在请求启动阶段、即正常模块初始化完成之前，就会解析 RFC1867 多部分（multipart）请求。

sents.en: Session upload-progress handling can initialize Session state at this early stage and publish a session ID in PS(id) .
sents.zh: 会话上传进度处理可以在此早期阶段初始化会话状态，并在 PS(id) 中发布一个会话 ID。

sents.en: An out-of-memory error can abort the request before cleanup completes.
sents.zh: 内存不足错误可能在清理完成之前中止请求。

sents.en: PHP then destroys the request heap and may leave PS(id) pointing to the freed allocation.
sents.zh: 随后 PHP 会销毁请求堆，可能使 PS(id) 仍然指向已被释放的内存分配。

paragraphs.en: A later multipart request handled by the same worker can reach the upload-progress cleanup path before normal Session initialization resets that pointer. PHP trusts the stale pointer and length as a live zend_string and URL-encodes the reclaimed heap contents into a PHPSESSID response cookie. The attack works even when the application never calls session_start() , making the issue application-agnostic. We demonstrated unauthenticated disclosure of an attacker-sized region of live worker memory containing data from outside the attacker's request.
paragraphs.zh: 由同一个 worker 处理的后续 multipart 请求，可能在正常的 Session 初始化重置该指针之前，先到达上传进度清理路径。 PHP 将过期的指针和长度当作存活的 zend_string 信任，并把被回收的堆内容 URL 编码进 PHPSESSID 响应 cookie 中。 即使应用程序从不调用 session_start()，该攻击也能奏效，因此该问题与应用程序无关。 我们演示了未经身份验证即可泄露 worker 内存中攻击者所指定大小的存活区域，其中包含来自攻击者请求之外的数据。

sents.en: A later multipart request handled by the same worker can reach the upload-progress cleanup path before normal Session initialization resets that pointer.
sents.zh: 由同一个 worker 处理的后续 multipart 请求，可能在正常的 Session 初始化重置该指针之前，先到达上传进度清理路径。

sents.en: PHP trusts the stale pointer and length as a live zend_string and URL-encodes the reclaimed heap contents into a PHPSESSID response cookie.
sents.zh: PHP 将过期的指针和长度当作存活的 zend_string 信任，并把被回收的堆内容 URL 编码进 PHPSESSID 响应 cookie 中。

sents.en: The attack works even when the application never calls session_start() , making the issue application-agnostic.
sents.zh: 即使应用程序从不调用 session_start()，该攻击也能奏效，因此该问题与应用程序无关。

sents.en: We demonstrated unauthenticated disclosure of an attacker-sized region of live worker memory containing data from outside the attacker's request.
sents.zh: 我们演示了未经身份验证即可泄露 worker 内存中攻击者所指定大小的存活区域，其中包含来自攻击者请求之外的数据。

paragraphs.en: In affected versions, PHP retains the backtrace of the most recent fatal error in EG(last_fatal_error_backtrace) . A fatal out-of-memory error can destroy the request heap without undefining that executor-global value. The worker survives with a global that still points to memory from the previous request.
paragraphs.zh: 在受影响的版本中，PHP 会将最近一次致命错误的调用回溯保留在 EG(last_fatal_error_backtrace) 中。 致命的内存溢出错误可能会销毁请求堆，而不会取消定义该执行器全局值。 该工作进程会继续存活，但其全局变量仍指向上一个请求的内存。

sents.en: In affected versions, PHP retains the backtrace of the most recent fatal error in EG(last_fatal_error_backtrace) .
sents.zh: 在受影响的版本中，PHP 会将最近一次致命错误的调用回溯保留在 EG(last_fatal_error_backtrace) 中。

sents.en: A fatal out-of-memory error can destroy the request heap without undefining that executor-global value.
sents.zh: 致命的内存溢出错误可能会销毁请求堆，而不会取消定义该执行器全局值。

sents.en: The worker survives with a global that still points to memory from the previous request.
sents.zh: 该工作进程会继续存活，但其全局变量仍指向上一个请求的内存。

paragraphs.en: If the same worker emits a diagnostic early in the next request, it can access the pointer before the executor reinitializes that state. PHP then destroys or updates the dangling backtrace and follows attacker-reclaimed memory. The resulting cross-request use-after-free can be developed into controlled memory corruption. We demonstrated unauthenticated remote code execution against Drupal using this primitive.
paragraphs.zh: 如果同一个 worker 在下一个请求的早期发出诊断信息，它就可以在执行器重新初始化该状态之前访问该指针。 PHP 随后销毁或更新这个悬空的回溯，并跟随攻击者重新占用的内存。 由此产生的跨请求释放后使用（use-after-free）可以被发展为受控的内存破坏。 我们利用这一原语演示了对 Drupal 的未经身份验证的远程代码执行。

sents.en: If the same worker emits a diagnostic early in the next request, it can access the pointer before the executor reinitializes that state.
sents.zh: 如果同一个 worker 在下一个请求的早期发出诊断信息，它就可以在执行器重新初始化该状态之前访问该指针。

sents.en: PHP then destroys or updates the dangling backtrace and follows attacker-reclaimed memory.
sents.zh: PHP 随后销毁或更新这个悬空的回溯，并跟随攻击者重新占用的内存。

sents.en: The resulting cross-request use-after-free can be developed into controlled memory corruption.
sents.zh: 由此产生的跨请求释放后使用（use-after-free）可以被发展为受控的内存破坏。

sents.en: We demonstrated unauthenticated remote code execution against Drupal using this primitive.
sents.zh: 我们利用这一原语演示了对 Drupal 的未经身份验证的远程代码执行。

paragraphs.en: OPcache persists compiled PHP structures in shared memory and assigns indices into per-worker runtime-pointer maps. Workers coordinate those indices through a shared frontier. During zend_accel_script_persist() , PHP advances the process-local CG(map_ptr_last) frontier. It publishes the corresponding shared frontier only after persistence completes. An allocation failure between those two events leaves the process-local advance in place and partially persisted objects referring to slots that the shared state still considers available.
paragraphs.zh: OPcache 将编译后的 PHP 结构保存在共享内存中，并将索引分配到每个工作进程的运行时指针映射中。 工作进程通过一个共享的边界（frontier）来协调这些索引。 在 zend_accel_script_persist() 执行期间，PHP 会推进进程本地的 CG(map_ptr_last) 边界。 只有在持久化完成后，它才会发布相应的共享边界。 如果在这两个事件之间发生内存分配失败，进程本地的推进仍然会保留，而部分持久化的对象会引用共享状态仍视为可用的槽位。

sents.en: OPcache persists compiled PHP structures in shared memory and assigns indices into per-worker runtime-pointer maps.
sents.zh: OPcache 将编译后的 PHP 结构保存在共享内存中，并将索引分配到每个工作进程的运行时指针映射中。

sents.en: Workers coordinate those indices through a shared frontier.
sents.zh: 工作进程通过一个共享的边界（frontier）来协调这些索引。

sents.en: During zend_accel_script_persist() , PHP advances the process-local CG(map_ptr_last) frontier.
sents.zh: 在 zend_accel_script_persist() 执行期间，PHP 会推进进程本地的 CG(map_ptr_last) 边界。

sents.en: It publishes the corresponding shared frontier only after persistence completes.
sents.zh: 只有在持久化完成后，它才会发布相应的共享边界。

sents.en: An allocation failure between those two events leaves the process-local advance in place and partially persisted objects referring to slots that the shared state still considers available.
sents.zh: 如果在这两个事件之间发生内存分配失败，进程本地的推进仍然会保留，而部分持久化的对象会引用共享状态仍视为可用的槽位。

paragraphs.en: When another worker later reuses one of those slots for a different runtime object, stale shared metadata resolves to a pointer of the wrong type. The mismatch creates a cross-worker type confusion and corrupts shared OPcache state. We used this primitive to build an unauthenticated RCE chain against WordPress.
paragraphs.zh: 当另一个 worker 稍后将其中一个槽位复用于不同的运行时对象时，过期的共享元数据会被解析为错误类型的指针。 这种不匹配造成了跨 worker 的类型混淆，并破坏了共享的 OPcache 状态。 我们利用这一原语构建了一条针对 WordPress 的无需身份验证的 RCE 攻击链。

sents.en: When another worker later reuses one of those slots for a different runtime object, stale shared metadata resolves to a pointer of the wrong type.
sents.zh: 当另一个 worker 稍后将其中一个槽位复用于不同的运行时对象时，过期的共享元数据会被解析为错误类型的指针。

sents.en: The mismatch creates a cross-worker type confusion and corrupts shared OPcache state.
sents.zh: 这种不匹配造成了跨 worker 的类型混淆，并破坏了共享的 OPcache 状态。

sents.en: We used this primitive to build an unauthenticated RCE chain against WordPress.
sents.zh: 我们利用这一原语构建了一条针对 WordPress 的无需身份验证的 RCE 攻击链。

paragraphs.en: There are other variants outside of these four bugs. While we initially reported these four to PHP, through this research we realized the vulnerability is deeply rooted in the PHP codebase and will require a comprehensive fix. Other variants should also fold under the same two CVEs.
paragraphs.zh: 在这四个漏洞之外还存在其他变体。 虽然我们最初向 PHP 报告了这四个漏洞，但通过这项研究，我们意识到该漏洞深深根植于 PHP 代码库之中，需要进行全面的修复。 其他变体也应归入同样的两个 CVE 之下。

sents.en: There are other variants outside of these four bugs.
sents.zh: 在这四个漏洞之外还存在其他变体。

sents.en: While we initially reported these four to PHP, through this research we realized the vulnerability is deeply rooted in the PHP codebase and will require a comprehensive fix.
sents.zh: 虽然我们最初向 PHP 报告了这四个漏洞，但通过这项研究，我们意识到该漏洞深深根植于 PHP 代码库之中，需要进行全面的修复。

sents.en: Other variants should also fold under the same two CVEs.
sents.zh: 其他变体也应归入同样的两个 CVE 之下。

paragraphs.en: Wiz customers should refer to the Wiz Threat Intel Center advisory for PHP2Shell , which includes built-in coverage for agentless and runtime vulnerability detection, exploitation detection via Wiz Defend and Sensor, and automatic response policies, alongside remediation and threat hunting guidance.
paragraphs.zh: Wiz 客户应参阅 Wiz 威胁情报中心（Threat Intel Center）发布的关于 PHP2Shell 的公告，其中包含针对无智能体（agentless）和运行时漏洞检测的内置覆盖、通过 Wiz Defend 和 Sensor 进行的利用行为检测，以及自动响应策略，同时还提供修复和威胁狩猎指导。

paragraphs.en: With 70% of the Internet affected, the impact of PHP2Shell cannot be overstated. It marks an AI inflection point. The vulnerable code had been there for more than a decade – what AI changed was the ability to understand the weaknesses and turn them into a working exploit. With frontier AI models and the right tools, a single researcher completed in a week what previously would have taken a world-class team months of work.
paragraphs.zh: 随着互联网70%的面积受到影响，PHP2Shell 的影响怎么强调都不为过。 它标志着一个智能体的转折点。 漏洞代码已经存在了十多年——智能体所改变的，是理解这些弱点并将其转化为可用漏洞利用程序的能力。 借助前沿智能体模型和合适的工具，一名研究人员在一周内完成了过去需要世界级团队数月才能完成的工作。

sents.en: With 70% of the Internet affected, the impact of PHP2Shell cannot be overstated.
sents.zh: 随着互联网70%的面积受到影响，PHP2Shell 的影响怎么强调都不为过。

sents.en: It marks an AI inflection point.
sents.zh: 它标志着一个智能体的转折点。

sents.zh: 漏洞代码已经存在了十多年——智能体所改变的，是理解这些弱点并将其转化为可用漏洞利用程序的能力。

sents.en: With frontier AI models and the right tools, a single researcher completed in a week what previously would have taken a world-class team months of work.
sents.zh: 借助前沿智能体模型和合适的工具，一名研究人员在一周内完成了过去需要世界级团队数月才能完成的工作。

paragraphs.en: This changes the economics of both discovery and exploitation. Vulnerabilities that once seemed impractical to exploit become viable targets. These same capabilities also give defenders a chance to uncover and fix flaws that have survived years of scrutiny.
paragraphs.zh: 这改变了发现与利用两方面的经济学。 曾经看似难以实际利用的漏洞变成了可行的攻击目标。 这些相同的能力也让防御者有机会发现并修复那些历经多年审查却依然存在的缺陷。

sents.zh: 这些相同的能力也让防御者有机会发现并修复那些历经多年审查却依然存在的缺陷。

paragraphs.en: Wiz used Wiz Atlas, Gemini 4 Argon, and GPT-5.6 Sol throughout this research, with Argon making a particularly significant contribution to finding and helping to remediate the vulnerability.
paragraphs.zh: Wiz 在整个研究过程中使用了 Wiz Atlas、Gemini 4 Argon 和 GPT-5.6 Sol，其中 Argon 在发现并协助修复该漏洞方面做出了尤为重要的贡献。

paragraphs.en: The opportunity is to make this work routine: systematically finding flaws in existing software and catching new ones before they reach production. Our coordinated efforts with PHP, OpenAI and Calif advance that goal, applying AI to strengthen the software foundations we all share.
paragraphs.zh: 机遇在于让这项工作成为常规：系统地发现现有软件中的缺陷，并在新缺陷进入生产环境之前将其捕获。 我们与 PHP、OpenAI 和 Calif 的协同努力正推进这一目标，将 AI 应用于强化我们共同依赖的软件基础。

paragraphs.en: August 19, 2026: Wiz Research discovers the first PHP vulnerability using Wiz Atlas, Gemini 4 Argon, and GPT-5.6 Sol.
paragraphs.zh: 2026年8月19日：Wiz Research 使用 Wiz Atlas、Gemini 4 Argon 和 GPT-5.6 Sol 发现了首个 PHP 漏洞。

paragraphs.en: August 20, 2026: Unauthenticated RCE is confirmed against Drupal.
paragraphs.zh: 2026年8月20日：针对 Drupal 的未经身份验证的远程代码执行（RCE）已得到确认。

paragraphs.en: August 21, 2026: Unauthenticated RCE is confirmed against WordPress.
paragraphs.zh: 2026年8月21日：确认存在针对 WordPress 的未授权远程代码执行（RCE）。

paragraphs.en: August 24, 2026: Wiz Research reports the vulnerabilities to the PHP security team.
paragraphs.zh: 2026年8月24日：Wiz Research 向 PHP 安全团队报告了这些漏洞。

paragraphs.en: September 21, 2026: PHP acknowledges the reports and begins developing a coordinated fix.
paragraphs.zh: 2026年9月21日：PHP 确认收到报告，并开始开发协调修复方案。

paragraphs.en: October 21, 2026: Patched PHP releases become available.
paragraphs.zh: 2026年10月21日：修补后的 PHP 版本发布。

paragraphs.en: Hi there! We are Sagi Tzadik, Shir Tamari, Nir Ohfeld and Tomer Schwartz from the Wiz Research Team ( @wiz_io ). We are a group of veteran white-hat hackers with a single goal: to make the cloud a safer place for everyone. We focus on finding new attack vectors in cloud software and uncovering isolation issues in the systems organizations depend on. We would love to hear from you on X or at research@wiz.io .

paragraphs.en: In a new incident, a malicious version (1.107.0) of the LiteLLM package was uploaded to PyPI and Docker on October 21. The malicious version includes a credential stealer targeting browser, cloud and AI secrets as well as a dormant C2 capability.
paragraphs.zh: 在一起新的事件中，一个恶意版本（1.107.0）的 LiteLLM 软件包于 10 月 21 日被上传到 PyPI 和 Docker。 该恶意版本包含一个窃取凭据的程序，目标是浏览器、云和 AI 的机密信息，同时还包括一个休眠的 C2 能力。
